suspects.description: Raw hex address 0x1c775ec assigned to bare local `iVar5`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `iVar5` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.
Ghidra mistranslated a Watcom float bit-pattern compare as `(int)x`. Hex 0x42c80000 is the IEEE 754 bit pattern of 100f. Rewrite in a .keep as a plain float compare against 100f.
